question.text: Under Rule 8 of SCRR, a person engaged as principal or employee in any business other than securities is:

answer.text: Automatically eligible for stock exchange membership
Permanently barred from stock exchange membership
Ineligible unless she/he undertakes on admission to sever the connection with such business
Eligible only with Central Government approval

explanation.text: The Logic: Rule 8 states that a person engaged as principal or employee in any business other than that of securities or commodity derivatives is ineligible unless she/he undertakes on admission to sever that connection. The Trap: The person is not permanently barred; eligibility is restored by giving an undertaking to sever the non-securities/non-commodity-derivatives business connection. Note: The Rule 8 cure is the undertaking on admission to sever the connection with the other business.
